reader_question: How has the number of applications to start a business changed since 2005?
grade_line: Documented: a Census Bureau count of applications for a tax ID
title: Americans filed 5.7 million applications to start a business in 2025, more than twice the 2.5 million of 2005
measure_line: Applications for a federal tax ID that signal a new business, each year from 2005, the first full year the Census Bureau publishes, to 2025, United States
source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, Business Formation Statistics, business applications, 2005 to 2025, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Applications for a tax ID that signal a new business; many never hire; annual totals summed by Oath & Action.
notes: Many applications never become a business that hires anyone, so the count measures plans to start one.
alt: The same 21 years of business applications as bars sorted by size, from 2025 at the top to 2009 at the bottom, so the years run out of order.
